title.en: Hailuo H3. Closed laundromat, one violin, the dryers keep time.
title.zh: Hailuo H3. Closed laundromat, one violin, the dryers keep time.

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 cinematic story prompt with attached video evidence from @GlennHasABeard.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3电影叙事提示词。

prompt:
"the dryer drums fall into rhythm with the bowing, their tumbling clothes turning over exactly on the strong beats"

Duration: 15s. Camera: locked, center aisle.

The dryers are what sell it. Give the impossible thing one mundane witness that reacts and the scene reads as real.
